name: AR_SELECTION_CRITERIA
description: AR_SELECTION_CRITERIA contains the selection criteria that are used by the Create Automatic Bills Receivable Batch process to determine which transactions to include in a new batch of bills receivable.

columns.name: SELECTION_CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a selection criteria.

columns.name: DUE_DATE_LOW
columns.description: Lower limit of a range of transaction due dates.

columns.name: DUE_DATE_HIGH
columns.description: Upper limit of a range of transaction due dates.

columns.name: TRX_DATE_LOW
columns.description: Lower limit of a range of transaction dates.

columns.name: TRX_DATE_HIGH
columns.description: Upper limit of a range of transaction dates.

columns.name: CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a transaction type.

columns.name: RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a receipt method on a transaction.

columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a bank branch on a transaction.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER_LOW
columns.description: Lower limit of a range of transaction numbers.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER_HIGH
columns.description: Upper limit of a range of transaction numbers.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Code of the transaction customer's class.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the transaction customer's category.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction's customer.

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction customer's site use.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
